description: Land Acquisition - Beliwila, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of a specific parcel of land (extent, location, lot number, name, claimants) and outlines the legal process for acquisition and compensation claims. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition for public purpose, which is a core land and property-related matter.
